sub_sector.value: Health savings account custody; employee benefits administration

financial_business_type.detail: Provides HSAs and administers FSAs, HRAs, commuter benefits and COBRA, with debit-card payments and premium collection.

revenue_driver.detail: Charges for end-to-end benefits administration and offers bundled pricing.

customer_type.detail: Serves employers, individual HSA members, health plans and public-sector employers.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Administers benefit accounts and handles premium collections. HSA members bear investment risk.

notes: The evidence leaves the revenue and balance-sheet exposure associated with HSA cash balances unclear.
